Streaming Response

Animated streaming text with typewriter effect, blinking cursor, and progress indicators for real-time AI responses.

Typewriter Text

Text with a blinking cursor that simulates live streaming.

React Server Components represent a fundamental shift in how we think about rendering. They allow you to write components that run exclusively on the server, reducing the JavaScript bundle size sent to the client.

Streaming Complete

Final state after streaming finishes, with a completion indicator.

React Server Components are a powerful addition to the React ecosystem. They enable better performance through reduced client-side JavaScript while maintaining the component model developers love. Consider using them for data-fetching components that don't need interactivity.

HTML
.zak-ai-stream              /* Streaming text container with cursor */

.zak-ai-stream-progress     /* Progress indicator row */
.zak-ai-stream-progress-bar /* Progress bar track */
.zak-ai-stream-progress-fill/* Animated progress fill */
.zak-ai-stream-dots         /* Bouncing dots container */
.zak-ai-stream-dot          /* Individual bouncing dot */
.zak-ai-stream-complete     /* Completed state (checkmark) */
.zak-ai-stream-code         /* Streaming code block */
.zak-ai-stream-line-anim    /* Line reveal animation */
.zak-ai-stream-chars        /* Character-by-character animation */

/* Key Animations */
@keyframes stream-blink   { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0} }
@keyframes stream-pulse   { 0%,100%{opacity:0.3} 30%{opacity:1} }
@keyframes stream-progress{ 0%{width:10%} 50%{width:70%} 100%{width:100%} }

JavaScript

Typewriter animation for simulating streaming.

HTML
function typewriterStream(element, text, speed = 30) {
    let i = 0;
    const cursor = element.querySelector('.zak-ai-stream-cursor');
    element.textContent = '';

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if (i < text.length) {
            element.insertBefore(
                document.createTextNode(text.charAt(i)),
                cursor
            );
            i++;
        } else {
            clearInterval(interval);
        }
    }, speed);
}

// Usage
const el = document.getElementById('stream-text-demo');
if (el) {
    typewriterStream(el,
        'React Server Components represent a fundamental shift...',
        25
    );
}
